success.description: Place a tracking token on this card. You may discard it anytime before this card.

boon.description: You recover 1 additional fatigue, stress, and wound during this night’s rest (even exceeding your Toughness score).

bane.description: Recharges to re-roll all {Dm} and {De} for a single check.
You recover 1 fewer fatigue, stress, and wound during this night’s rest.

chaosStar.description: You wake up with a supernatural insanity.

conservative.requirements: Seek S favour. You must fall asleep as you use this action. It recharges at sundown each day. Effect: You ask Morr to send you a dream that offers wisdom or guidance for your course ahead. You make your check, and then the GM describes your dream. The better your results, the more information he may choose to give you (cryptic as it may be!). In addition, this blessing has other effects described below.
